description.value: Kerala Kitchen is an award-winning South Indian restaurant in Surrey, earning 1st Place at the Vancouver Foodster Curry Challenge 2024 and an official appreciation from the City of Surrey. The menu centres on traditional Kerala cuisine — fresh-made dosas, coastal curries, and Indo-Chinese dishes drawn from family recipes — and the restaurant has amassed over 2,200 Google reviews. A spacious, welcoming dining room makes it a comfortable stop for groups or solo travellers passing through the Scott Road corridor.
